semantic.bar: names a plausible future and justifies it from pull, push and weight together
semantic.instructions: Does the section in `items[{i}]` justify its plausible future by drawing on the pull of images, the pushes and the weights together?

criteria.true: Explains why this future is plausible by referring to which image pulls, which trends push toward it, and which barriers hold other images back.
criteria.false: Names a plausible future with no reasoning, or reasons from only one of pull, push and weight.

semantic.bar: derives three or four scenarios, each built on a named image or driver
semantic.instructions: Is the scenario in `items[{i}]` explicitly built on a named image of the future or a named driver?

criteria.true: Says which image or driver it rests on, for example '(Gaia wins through policy and habit)' or 'key driver: regulatory push'.
criteria.false: Describes a future without saying which image or driver it is built on.

semantic.bar: ends with a Handoff naming the next method and why
semantic.instructions: Does the section in `items[{i}]` name a next method to use and give a reason for choosing it?

criteria.true: Names a method (for example fdbx-four-futures, fdbx-causal-layered-analysis) and says what it would do with this output.
criteria.false: Names no method, or names one with no reason.
